$comment: Control-plane bounds, not strategy thresholds. Dynamic scheduling is opt-in until production soak. Cycle deadline is cooperative: never release an unfinished evaluation as though cancelled. Provider pacing and concurrency remain canonical.
$commentDailyCacheTail: Refresh scheduling only, not a freshness certificate or exchange calendar: four calendar days tolerate a normal weekend plus one holiday. Longer gaps must try the canonical provider even when row count is sufficient. Five-minute retry cooldown matches the ordinary Quant cycle and bounds repeated failed refreshes; cached fallback behavior is unchanged.
